_comment: Rơi đồ theo tu vi (2026-11-20): good loot unlocks only as the player climbs. Read by app/systems/loot.py and checked by loot.validate() (tools/check_all.py). A tier is a cultivation realm of realms_cultivation.json, optionally ':stage' ('luyen_khi:4', 'truc_co:1'); a realm without a stage means its first stage. items: the tu vi at which an item starts dropping for a player from monsters, bí cảnh, hầm ngục and cơ duyên (shop, quests, gacha, crafting, fishing and alchemy are not gated). Every item of a loot table must be listed here (the ghi chú lỗi sai of math/drops.json, kind note, are never gated); an unlisted item counts as locked below the top tier. equipment_rarity: the tu vi at which each rarity of equipment may drop. source_caps: the highest tier a wild zone (zones.json) or a bí cảnh (realms.json) may list at all, counting the monsters that spawn there; null = no cap. A breakthrough pill and everything it is brewed from unlock no later than the last stage of the realm it breaks out of.
